summary: Comprehensive E2E testing of EDUSENSE: 22/22 backend pytest cases pass (public, auth register/login/me, role mismatch 403, astrology niche+history, recommendations, students RBAC, principal-only analytics). Frontend Playwright flows pass for landing, parent register -> astrology -> recommendations, teacher register + add student, principal login + analytics charts, role-mismatch error display. LLM-backed endpoints (Claude Sonnet 4.5) returned valid parsed JSON within 30s.

ui_bugs.component: PrincipalDashboard - Users by role pie chart
ui_bugs.issue: Recharts emits 'width(-1) and height(-1)' warnings; only the legend (Parents, Principals, Teachers) renders, the pie itself is not visible in the [data-testid=chart-roles] card. Likely the parent container has no explicit height or ResponsiveContainer is missing minHeight.

issues: Uses native browser <input type='date'> and <input type='time'> instead of shadcn calendar/time pickers (per design guideline). Functionally fine.

action_items: Fix Users-by-role pie chart in PrincipalDashboard (wrap in container with explicit height, e.g., h-[280px], or set ResponsiveContainer width/height correctly).
(Optional) Replace native date/time inputs on Astrology page with shadcn date/time pickers for design consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') hooks; consider migrating to lifespan context manager.
JWT_SECRET is committed in /app/backend/.env (acceptable for preview but ensure rotation in prod).

CORS_ORIGINS='*' combined with allow_credentials=True is technically inconsistent (browsers block credentials with wildcard). Not blocking here since auth uses Bearer header, not cookies, but worth tightening for production.
Login error message 'This account is registered as parent, not teacher' leaks role info; acceptable per UX, but consider generic message for stricter security posture.
Astrology and Recommendations LLM calls have no timeout/abort; long stalls could exhaust workers under load.
test_credentials: Pre-seeded principal: principal@edusense.com / Admin@123. Test users created at runtime with TS suffix.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed users/students; backend seeds principal admin on startup (idempotent password sync confirmed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py uses unique TS-suffixed emails per run; safe to re-run. LLM endpoints take 5-30s (use timeout >=60s). Principal seed is auto-created/updated. Only outstanding minor UI bug is the empty Users-by-role pie chart on principal dashboard.
rca of the issue: Users-by-role chart RCA: Recharts ResponsiveContainer requires a parent with computed height. The Card holding [data-testid=chart-roles] likely has no fixed height while ResponsiveContainer uses height='100%', resolving to 0. Fix: set explicit height (e.g., <div className='h-72'><ResponsiveContainer ...>) or pass height={280} directly.
